candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show order-side 500s (HTTPStatusError) for every checkout correlation, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout in 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db, payment, inventory) not established; order-side logs/traces excluded. Gateway 502 is a downstream symptom, not the origin.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order-service 500s on POST /v1/orders across all sampled correlations, and gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. This bounds the fault to order-service failure surfaced via gateway, but the specific internal cause (db-pool, payment, inventory) is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Dependency metrics for order->postgresql, order->payment, order->inventory outcomes
